title: The All-Seeing Eye
author: Unknown
description: An issue of The All-Seeing Eye, the monthly magazine 'Modern Problems in the Light of Ancient Wisdom' written, edited and compiled by Manly P. Hall in Los Angeles, here the number for May 1923, early in Hall's career and five years before The Secret Teachings of All Ages. Distributed free rather than sold, it presents short essays on symbolism, philosophy and esoteric interpretations of current problems. Articles listed in this issue include 'Nonsense as a Factor in Soul Growth' and 'Atlantis, the Lost Continent', alongside Hall's characteristic commentary on the mystery schools, occult anatomy and the spiritual path. It is a primary document of Hall's early teaching and of 1920s American esotericism, and complements his major work held in the library.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
